policy: Original multiplex events and original child streams; fitted frame comes from polygon map source, never lines. Native multiplex can interleave open child components; its real events and nesting counts are preserved and its point multiset checked against children. Regional geometry comparison uses original child streams to avoid interpreting interleaved events as safe bridges. Compare material components by region and open path bounds plus bidirectional vertex/midpoint-to-segment distance after affine normalization. Chord error is .02*(1+1/(1-mapFitRelativeLimit)); endpoint clip amplification is frozen from original native boundary crossing angles. Geometric 2px tube coverage excludes only the recorded native threshold band, at least .05px, expanded by the same native error bound. All raw short/touch components remain recorded; length<=.05px is diagnostic, not material topology equality. This does not verify painted stroke masks.
